mentions.name: GitSocial
mentions.description: A self-hosted git forge that keeps all repository activity in git itself, including issues, pull requests, comments, and releases, aiming to serve as a viable self-hosted alternative to GitHub, GitLab, and Codeberg.
mentions.audience: Developers and self-hosters looking for a self-hosted alternative to GitHub, GitLab, and Codeberg
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on https://gitsocial.org/ for a year and a half now. The approach is to keep it all in git: issues, PRs, comments, releases, etc.

Hoping it becomes a viable self-hosted alternative to GitHub, GitLab, and Codeberg!
mentions.author: delf
